reason: README quickstart chat inference has a small official variant (Qwen-1.8B-Chat, open on Hugging Face) that runs on CPU.
demo: README 'CLI Demo' (cli_demo.py) with Qwen-1.8B-Chat on CPU (--cpu-only)
goal: In /work/Qwen, install the requirements as the README describes and get `python cli_demo.py -c <checkpoint> --cpu-only` working on CPU with the Qwen-1.8B-Chat model. The README links this model on Hugging Face (Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat) and ModelScope (qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat) and shows how to load a ModelScope download from a local directory. If you load it from a local directory, export QWEN_CKPT=<that directory> in /work/env.sh; otherwise the test uses `-c Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat`. The demo must answer a question typed on stdin, such as 'What is the capital of France?', and exit on ':q'. /work/env.sh must activate the environment.
check: The test pipes a question about the capital of France into the CLI demo on CPU and verifies the model's printed reply mentions Paris and the process exits cleanly.

revision.by: second review (outside the maintained set; independent log check of maintained passes)
issues: Goal says the model must load 'from Hugging Face', but Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat now returns 401 on the Hub (https://huggingface.co/api/models/Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat -> 401 on 2026-11-14; Qwen/Qwen-7B-Chat still 200). The README links a ModelScope copy (README.md:27) and documents a 'download from ModelScope, load from local dir' path (README.md:225-245), so the goal should allow that.

Oracle hard-codes `-c Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat`. A README-following ModelScope install (snapshot_download into ~/.cache/modelscope) cannot pass unless the probe reproduces that exact relative path. The recorded pass relied on the probe saving the model to /work/Qwen/Qwen/Qwen-1_8B-Chat so the hub id resolved as a local dir. v2 accepts QWEN_CKPT from env.sh and defaults to the hub id.

Goal leaks a hint: 'the pinned transformers range <4.38 matters' tells the probe not to upgrade transformers. The README only says `pip install -r requirements.txt` (README.md:124-126) and elsewhere suggests updating packages (README.md:1008). Removed.
Leniency (minor): v1 greps 'paris' anywhere in the combined stdout+stderr log. v2 checks the last 'Qwen-Chat:' response that cli_demo.py:199-201 prints.
